readings: Looking at how much each film rating gets rented (going from rentals through the inventory copy to the film), take the ratings that are above the average across ratings. Give me one row: the average figure for those ratings and how far above the overall average they are on average. No rounding.
queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental re
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM r
)
SELECT AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_rentals_above_avg_ratings,
       AVG(r.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_difference_above_overall_avg
FROM r, a
WHERE r.cnt > a.avg_cnt;
